ai.headline: Amazon moves most disputes from court to binding arbitration, with class action waiver
ai.summary: Amazon now requires most disputes about its services, products, or sales to be settled through binding arbitration instead of court, and bars class actions, so individuals can only pursue individual claims. Small claims court, certain injunctive relief requests, and disputes over the required pre-arbitration process remain open to court, and the Washington state courts clause that previously governed disputes has been replaced.
